pairs.statement: Failing agreement when three months from the notification have run, disputes under this title go by summons to the court where the building lies.
Subletting in whole or in part is forbidden unless the lease allows it or the lessor consents.

The losing owner may escape the compensation by accepting renewal and bearing the costs within fifteen days of the judgment becoming final, while the lessee is still in the premises and has not leased or bought another building.
pairs.missingOrWrong: «ولا يجوز ممارسة هذا الحق مادام المستأجر مازال موجودا في الاماكن وما دام لم يؤجر أو لم يشتر عمارة أخرى» prohibits exercise in the stated situation. For a judicial-council judgment, the period starts «ابتداء من يوم صدور الحكم», rather than when it becomes final.

pairs.statement: A renewed lease runs for the length of the previous one, not beyond nine years, unless the parties agree otherwise.
The renewal request is served on the lessor by extrajudicial act, may be handed to a manager entitled to receive it, and must contain the wording of the paragraph set out after it, or it is void.
In that case the summons must be served within three months of the notification of the refusal to renew.
This right to take back cannot be used on premises fitted as a hotel, on furnished premises, or on hospital or school premises.
The commercial section of the court hears this claim.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT gives general jurisdiction rules but does not identify 'this claim' or establish that it falls within the commercial section's jurisdiction.

pairs.statement: A lease under these provisions ends only by a notice to quit given according to local usage at least six months before the term.

The time limit is 2 years, running from the date of lease action arose on; it is a limitation period, counted by the method excludeFirstDay; it applies when commercial lease is yes and lease chapter action other than refusal is yes.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not state that the two years start when the lease action arose. It excludes actions under articles 196 and 197 without identifying those exceptions as equivalent to 'refusal' actions.

pairs.statement: The provisions extend to leases granted to communes for municipal operating services and to leases of public economic enterprises, without effect on the public domain.
The lessor's answer must restate the content of the article on the dispute procedure, or it is void.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The supplied paragraph does not identify the notification as the lessor's answer or state that article 194 concerns the dispute procedure.

pairs.statement: The lessee has a priority right to lease in the rebuilt building under the conditions that follow.
When the lessor offers substitute premises, the lessee either accepts by extrajudicial act within three months or sues on the conditions set for a refusal to renew.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The supplied paragraph does not identify the situation as an offer of substitute premises; it refers to paragraph 2 without supplying its content.

pairs.statement: Renewal may be delayed up to three years to raise the building, against compensation not above three years' rent.
Failing agreement within the following three months, the request goes to the competent court and is decided under the procedure for fixing the lease terms.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT refers to articles 195 and 196 but does not state that they prescribe the procedure for fixing lease terms.

pairs.statement: The provisions also apply, subject to the special compensation provisions, to leases of premises owned by the State, wilayas, communes or public bodies when they meet the scope conditions.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT refers to articles 185 and 186 but does not identify them as special compensation provisions.

pairs.statement: Renewal may also be refused without compensation if total or partial demolition for officially recognised unfitness, or the impossibility of safe occupation, is proven.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT states the demolition, officially recognised unfitness and unsafe-occupation conditions, but does not state the consequence of permitting refusal of renewal without compensation.

pairs.statement: The provisions cover bare land on which buildings for commercial, industrial or craft use were built or operated with the owner's express consent.
The new rent is due from the day of the request, unless the parties agree on another date.
When the lessor refuses renewal and the lessee wishes to contest the ground or claim eviction compensation, he sues the lessor before the court where the building lies.
Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and priority right in issue is yes, a prior step must have been taken.
pairs.missingOrWrong: No contract-date cutoff of 2005-02-09 is stated. The TEXT requires notice to benefit from the priority right, but does not expressly make it a prerequisite to filing a claim.

pairs.statement: Leases made from the date the amending law was published must be in official form on pain of nullity, for a term the parties set freely.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT refers to 'this law' («هذا القانون») but does not identify it as an amending law.

pairs.statement: Laws apply from the day of their publication in the Official Journal.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and lessee contests refusal or claims eviction compensation is yes and notice to quit valid is no, a prior step must have been taken.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not state the 2005-02-09 cutoff, equate an invalid notice with absence of notice, or make a renewal request a prerequisite to every action contesting refusal or claiming eviction compensation.

pairs.statement: The real-estate section hears in particular leases of dwellings and of professional premises.
The lessor must serve a reasoned refusal within three months of the renewal request, or he is deemed to agree to the principle of renewal.
Actions under this title other than those of the two preceding articles go to the court where the building lies and are time-barred after two years.
The court does not apply limitation of its own motion, only on the request of the debtor, his creditors or any interested person.
Bankruptcy or judicial liquidation does not by itself end the lease of the debtor's business premises; any contrary clause is void.
When the lessor accepts renewal and the dispute is about rent, duration or terms, the parties appear before the president of the court where the building lies, who rules under the summary procedure.
The lessee must leave the premises at the end of the agreed term, without a notice to quit and without eviction compensation, unless the parties stipulated otherwise.
When the lessee claims eviction compensation, the summary-matters judge may be asked to order an expert assessment before that period ends.
The renewal of leases made before that publication stays governed by the law in force when they were made.
Without a notice to quit, a lessee who wants renewal makes his request in the six months before the lease ends or at any time during its extension.
Where the lessor owns both building and business and the lease covers both, he owes the lessee on leaving an indemnity for the added value from material improvements agreed with the owner.

A failure to perform or a cessation of operation may be invoked only if it continued for more than a month after a warning by extrajudicial act stating the ground and restating the paragraph; otherwise the warning is void.
pairs.missingOrWrong: «تواصل ارتكابها أو تجديدها لاكثر من شهر» allows continuation or recurrence of the breach; the STATEMENT makes continuation alone necessary.

pairs.statement: During the case the lessee keeps paying the rent at the old rate or the provisional rate set.
When commercial lease is yes and dispute only on renewal terms or rent revision is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (otherSection).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT provides proceedings before the president of the competent court under the urgent procedure. It does not state that the case leaves the ordinary courts or assign it to 'otherSection'.

pairs.statement: The lessor may refuse renewal but must pay the eviction compensation equal to the harm caused by the refusal, save the listed exceptions.
Exception: where substitute premises were offered, the lessee leaves as soon as the provisional compensation fixed by the court president on an expert report is paid.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT refers to the situation in article 178 paragraph 2 but does not state that this situation involves an offer of substitute premises.

pairs.statement: The compensation includes the business's market value under trade usage, moving and reinstallation costs and transfer costs and duties, unless the owner proves a lesser harm.

The provisions do not apply to emphyteutic leases except for rent revision; they apply to leases made by way of a long-term lease, provided the renewal does not extend the sub-lessees' occupation beyond the end of the long-term lease.

The time limit is 3 months, running from the date of renewal refusal notified on; it is a procedural period; it applies when commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and lessee contests refusal or claims eviction compensation is yes.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT gives no publication date of 2005-02-09, so that contract-date cutoff is unsupported. It sets a summons-service deadline but does not expressly classify the period as procedural.

pairs.statement: The State, wilayas, communes and public bodies may not refuse renewal of leases of their buildings without paying the eviction compensation, even for public utility.
The lessor may refuse renewal without compensation if he proves a serious and legitimate ground against the lessee.
The provisions do not apply to temporary occupation permits granted by the administration for a building it acquired after a declaration of public utility.
Periods are counted by the Gregorian calendar unless the law says otherwise.
A lessee entitled to eviction compensation cannot be made to leave before receiving it and stays on the terms of the expired lease; the occupation indemnity is fixed under the rent provisions.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT says the occupation indemnity is fixed under Chapter V, but does not identify that chapter as the rent provisions.

pairs.statement: A lease under the Civil Code ends when the agreed term expires, with no need for a notice to quit.
Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and resolutory clause for unpaid rent relied on is yes, the debtor must first be put on notice (formal notice).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT makes an unheeded payment demand a condition for the termination clause to take effect after one month. It does not expressly make notice a prerequisite to filing a claim.

pairs.statement: The beneficiary of the take-back must occupy the premises within six months of the lessee leaving and for at least six years, failing which the evicted lessee keeps his right to eviction compensation.
pairs.missingOrWrong: «باستثناء السبب المشروع» qualifies the occupancy obligation with an exception for a legitimate reason; the STATEMENT presents the obligation and consequence unconditionally.

pairs.statement: The lessor may refuse renewal of the residential part attached to the premises to live there himself or have the listed relatives live there, on the stated conditions.
The lessor may refuse renewal in order to build or rebuild, paying the eviction compensation, or offering suitable premises in a similar place instead.
A lessee who shows a legitimate reason, or who let his business under a management lease on its legal conditions, may still rely on the operation.

Judges granting time to pay may suspend the clause's effects unless rescission was already established by a final judgment; the clause has no effect if the lessee clears his debt on the judge's terms.
A lessor who is also the seller of the business and has received the whole price may refuse renewal only by paying eviction compensation, unless he proves a serious or legitimate ground.
A limitation period is counted in days, the first day is not counted, and it is complete when its last day ends.

The commercial-lease provisions apply to leases of buildings or premises in which a business is operated that belongs to a trader, industrialist, craftsman or craft enterprise entered in the commercial register or the crafts register.
The same applies when the lessor refuses renewal on the terms fixed by the court.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT refers to terms fixed under article 195 but does not state in this extract that the court fixes those terms.

pairs.statement: Without a notice to quit, a written lease continues by tacit extension beyond its term.
The provisions cover accessory premises needed to operate the business, on the stated conditions.

Only a lessee, transferee or successor who proves he operated the business himself or through his staff for two consecutive years under one or more leases, or four consecutive years under successive oral or written leases, may claim the renewal right.
If the lessor used his rights fraudulently to defeat the lessee's rights, the lessee is owed compensation equal to the harm.
The commercial section hears commercial disputes other than those given to the specialised commercial court.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT excludes disputes mentioned in article 536 bis but does not state that those disputes are assigned to the specialised commercial court.

pairs.statement: Clauses that stop the lessee from assigning his lease to the buyer of his business, or make the buyer subject to the owner's approval, are void.
A lease under the Civil Code is made in writing with a fixed date, or it is void.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and the petition asks for eviction and not (the petition asks for rescission), a notice to quit must have been given.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT gives no publication date of 2005-02-09 and does not distinguish eviction petitions from rescission petitions. It requires notice to end the lease under article 173, rather than expressly stating the claimed prerequisite to filing suit.

pairs.statement: The lessee notifies the owner by extrajudicial act of his intent to use the priority right when leaving or within three months after, then has three months after the owner's offer to answer or sue.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT grants the later three-month period but does not state that it runs from the owner's offer; the paragraph describing the relevant notification is not supplied.

pairs.statement: A clause rescinding the lease by operation of law for unpaid rent takes effect only one month after an unheeded demand for payment, and the demand must mention that period.
Clauses and arrangements that defeat the renewal right created by this title are void.
A revision request may be made only after at least three years from the start of operation or of the renewed lease.
Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and refusal without compensation for breach is yes, the debtor must first be put on notice (formal notice).
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not state the 2005-02-09 cutoff or expressly make the warning a prerequisite to filing a claim. It makes the warning a condition for invoking the continuing or renewed breach.

pairs.statement: Laws take effect in the capital after a full day from publication, and elsewhere after a full day from the Official Journal's arrival at the daira's seat.
A rent revision request is made by extrajudicial act or registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt and must, on pain of nullity, state the rent asked or offered.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The supplied paragraph states the request's form and required rent amount but does not identify it as a rent revision request.

pairs.statement: On a transfer of the business the transferee may rely on the transferor's acquired rights to complete the period of personal operation.
The notice to quit must be an extrajudicial act stating its reasons and restating the content of the article on the dispute procedure, or it is void.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT requires restating article 194 but does not state in this extract that article 194 concerns the dispute procedure.
